source_refs.note: Chapter 5 summary (PDF 73), with its definitions arranged as a table.

blocks.text: This chapter showed how to make programs correct (testing and debugging), robust (exception handling) and fast (profiling and optimisation). The table brings together its main terms.

blocks.caption: Chapter 5 key terms
rows: Testing
Checking that a program works correctly and gives the expected output
Debugging
Finding and fixing errors or bugs
Bug
An error or fault that makes a program give a wrong result or behave unexpectedly
Programming error
A mistake in code, such as a syntax, logic or runtime error
Unit testing
Testing small parts, such as single functions, separately
Test case
A set of inputs, expected outputs and conditions for checking a program or function
unittest
Python's built-in module for creating and running test cases
pytest
A Python testing framework for writing and running simple, powerful tests
Breakpoint
A point where execution pauses so variables and behaviour can be checked
Watch expression
Monitors a variable or expression while the program runs step by step
Exception handling
Managing runtime errors so the program does not stop suddenly
Profiling
Measuring performance to find which code takes more time or resources
Optimisation
Improving code so it runs faster or uses fewer resources
Performance bottleneck
A part of a program that slows down the whole execution

items: Find errors: tests (unittest, pytest) and debugging tools (breakpoints, watches, stepping).
Speed up: profile, find the bottleneck, optimise, measure again.
